scope: actual H5 native landed decoder, 544 PMA / 512 payload shape; no whole-die simulation
golden: original H5 dsyn/ddly/LP, renamed modules only; same H flags; macro and Chien arithmetic models from pinned main
candidate: output-only separate face plus midpoint; DD55->54; no arithmetic/reduction change
stimulus: encoder-derived random 512-bit payloads; finite single and 16-symbol error injections; cold and two warm resets
comparison: controls every active post-reset edge; all payload/first/uncorrectable/nerr/seq bits on every valid output; wrong-DD control must fail in every epoch
steady_shape: same per-cycle q_v as old H5; 544-bit input, one word per cycle; no new stalls
